description: (Na)₂AgInCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a AgInCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the AgInCl₆ framework, Ag is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-Cl bond lengths are 2.67 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form InCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-Cl bond lengths are 2.54 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ag and one In atom.
